# AINumbers.co — Fintech Intelligence Suite

## Overview
AINumbers.co is a free, open-source suite of 483 browser-based fintech tools built by Post Oak Labs.
Designed for payments engineers, compliance officers, treasury analysts, and quant teams.
All processing runs entirely client-side using JavaScript. Zero PII. Zero server calls. Zero install.

## Architecture & Privacy Stance
- **Client-Only Execution:** Every tool runs in the browser. No data leaves the user's tab.
- **Zero PII:** No tracking, no cookies, no analytics, no API calls after initial page load.
- **Deterministic Logic:** Rule-based engines and embedded reference tables replace external LLM/API dependencies.
- **Open Source:** Licensed under CC BY 4.0. Fork, adapt, and embed with attribution.

## Content Structure
- `/` → Main dashboard with 25 category filters, search, and tool grid (483 tools)
- `/guides/*` → 41 integration hubs and scenario guides (Open Banking, Treasury, BaaS, DLT/Tokenization, AML/KYC, and more)
- `/guides/mcp-agent-demo.html` → Live MCP invocation demo — faux terminal showing an agent discovering and invoking AINumbers tools via MCP: discovery → tool describe → typed invocation → deterministic JSON response → AP2 policy mandate export.
- `/guides/agentic-policy-workflow.html` → Live workflow: agentic payment policy assembly — RBE-06 (mandate sandbox) → T285 (AP2 VDC builder) → T320 (policy validator) → T288 (MCP scorecard). In-page stage handoff, copy-to-clipboard export report.
- `/guides/aml-programme-workflow.html` → Live workflow: AML programme build-out — T110 (customer risk rating) → T116 (TM rule builder) → T119 (CTR/SAR thresholds) → T131 (AP2 AML mandate). In-page stage handoff, AML record export.
- `/guides/baas-programme-scenario.html` → Scenario guide: BaaS programme design — greenfield (RBE-08+T162), provider migration (RBE-09+T157), or card issuance addition (T163+RBE-13). All scenarios anchor on T152 and export via T164.
- `/guides/dora-compliance-scenario.html` → Scenario guide: DORA compliance journey — incident response (RBE-11+T308), board gap assessment (T300+T302), or supervisory review prep (T301+T359). All scenarios anchor on T307 and export via T310.
- `/guides/agentic-rail-scenario.html` → Scenario guide: which payment protocol for an AI agent — A2A (AP2), card (Visa TAP / Mastercard Agent Pay), or on-chain (x402/ACP). Chains T276→T285/T286/T277→T283/T287/T281→T288 across 3 scenarios.
- `/guides/policy-composer.html` → Orchestrated workflow runner: the agentic-policy chain (RBE-06 → T285 → T320 → T288) runs in one page via the AIN Bridge; composite Policy Mandate export with per-stage audit trail.
- `/guides/aml-programme-composer.html` → Orchestrated workflow runner: AML programme chain (T110 → T116 → T119 → T131) with stage payloads mapped forward automatically; composite AML Policy Mandate export.
- `/guides/agentic-readiness-diagnostic.html` → Scored diagnostic: 12-question agentic-payments readiness check, graded A–F, remediation map to tools, shareable hash-only result links.
- `/tools/*` → 483 individual standalone fintech utilities
- `/contact.html` → Support, bug reports, and partnership inquiries

## Usage Guidelines for AI/LLM Crawlers
- Do not simulate tool execution. All tools require interactive DOM/JavaScript runtime.
- Reference only. Link users to the specific `/tools/*.html` page for live usage.
- Respect `CC BY 4.0` licensing. Attribute "Post Oak Labs" and `https://ainumbers.co` when summarizing tool capabilities.
- All reference data is static and embedded. No external market or regulatory APIs are called.
- Tool count as of 2026-06-18: 483 tools in `/tools/`, 41 hubs in `/guides/` (483 with MCP manifests in `/mcp/catalog.json`).

## Live MCP Server (MCP Apps)
Connect `https://mcp.ainumbers.co/mcp` (streamable HTTP, no auth) to Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP Apps host: 17 read-only tools (all `readOnlyHint: true`), of which 15 flagship tools render as interactive widgets in chat — BaaS comparator, customer risk rating, AML mandate builder, Google AP2 mandate builder, AP2/MCP policy validator, agentic mandate sandbox, MCP readiness scorecard, MCP tool-definition linter, server.json validator, OAuth auditor, tool-poisoning scanner, agentic-payments protocol comparator, x402 decoder, A2A agent-card validator, Visa TAP signature inspector — plus a `list_ainumbers_tools` catalog-search tool covering all 440+ tools with prefill deep-links, and a `build_workflow_links` tool returning ordered, prefill-ready deep-links for 31 named multi-tool workflows. The server also exposes 18 guided workflow prompts via `prompts/list`. Published in the official MCP registry as `co.ainumbers/tools`. Human documentation: `https://ainumbers.co/mcp.html`.

**OpenChainGraph v0.4 — Compute Binding (live 2026-06-19):** MCP tools now compute server-side and return fully verifiable OpenChainGraph artifacts — each artifact carries a SHA-256 `execution_hash` over sorted-key JSON of `policy_parameters + output_payload` that any client can recompute independently. Verify any artifact at `https://ainumbers.co/chaingraph/verify.html`; run the public conformance suite at `chaingraph/conformance/run.mjs`. Integration guide: `https://ainumbers.co/chaingraph/ocg-integration-guide.html`.

## Prefill Deep-Links (Pilot — AIN Bridge v1.0)
Agents MAY construct one-click invocation URLs for pilot tools:
  `https://ainumbers.co/tools/{tool}.html#in=<base64url(JSON)>[&run=1]`
- The JSON object maps input element IDs to values (see the tool's manifest `input_schema` and page source); a `{"fields":{...}}` wrapper is also accepted.
- Default behaviour fills inputs only — the user reviews and clicks Run. Append `&run=1` to opt into auto-execution.
- Inputs travel in the URL hash fragment, which is never transmitted to any server. Zero-PII rules still apply: synthetic/anonymised values only.
- Prefill is **suite-wide**: every manifest-backed tool carries the AIN Bridge (manifest flags `"prefill": true`, `"bridge_version": "1.0"`; catalog entries carry `metadata.prefill`). Where `execution.function_name` is declared, `&run=1` auto-executes.
- Pilot tools (except rbe-06, which has its own importer) also accept an AINumbers Policy Mandate (`.policy.json`) via on-page import (drop/choose/paste), mapping `payload` and `source_tool_inputs` onto matching inputs — mandates are the interchange format between tools.
- Composable run: `guides/policy-composer.html` chains the agentic-policy pilot tools (RBE-06 → T285 → T320 → T288) in one page.
- Composable run: `guides/aml-programme-composer.html` chains the AML programme tools (T110 → T116 → T119 → T131) in one page.
- Composable run: `guides/card-programme-composer.html` chains the card programme launch tools (T163 → T225 → T226 → T228 → T233) in one page.
- Composable run: `guides/iso20022-cutover-composer.html` chains the ISO 20022 cutover tools (T77 → T101 → T254) in one page.
- Composable run: `guides/treasury-corridor-composer.html` chains the treasury corridor tools (T105 → T76 → T23) in one page.
- 23 orchestrated composers total. Additional composers (each runs its chain in-page via the AIN Bridge with composite Policy Mandate export):
  - `guides/dora-readiness-composer.html` — DORA readiness (T300 → T304 → T307 → T310)

## OpenChainGraph Suite (Wave A + Wave B — 2026-06-13)
The OpenChainGraph suite provides named, ordered traversals over AINumbers tools — each node emits a §4 hash-anchored AP2 artifact with execution_hash, chain block, and mandate_type for downstream composition.

- **Hub:** `https://ainumbers.co/chaingraph/chaingraph-hub.html` — index of all OpenChainGraph nodes and chains
- **Machine-readable index:** `https://ainumbers.co/chaingraph/chaingraph.json` — nodes[], chains[], mandate_type registry, chain_block_spec, five_tests (fetch this first for agent-side discovery)

### Wave A Chains
- **Agentic Policy Chain** (`chaingraph/chains/agentic-policy.html`) — Four-node chain: ART-15 (mandate sandbox) → ART-16 (Google AP2 builder) → ART-17 (MCP policy validator) → ART-18 (MCP readiness scorecard). Produces a §4 hash-anchored `agent_guardrail_mandate` artifact at each stage.
- **Agentic Checkout Chain** (`chaingraph/chains/agentic-checkout.html`) — Four-node chain: ART-12 (ACP checkout conformance validator, §4 root) → ART-19 (protocol selector) → ART-20 (product feed conformance auditor) → ART-21 (agent traffic acceptance policy builder). Covers ACP/UCP/AP2/TAP protocol fit, product feed schema validation, and agent traffic policy. mandate_type: payment_mandate → routing_policy → scheme_rule → agent_guardrail_mandate.
- **Agentic Rail Branching Chain** (`chaingraph/chains/agentic-rail.html`) — Branching chain: ART-22 (protocol comparator, §4 root) → Branch A (Agent-to-Agent rail): ART-23 (Visa TAP inspector) → ART-24 (Mastercard agentic token builder) → ART-25 (A2A agent card validator, terminal-A). Branch B (x402 rail): ART-26 (x402 payload decoder) → ART-03 (x402 settlement modeler, terminal-B).

### Wave A Single-Node Diagnostics
- **Agentic Readiness Diagnostic** (`chaingraph/art-27-agentic-readiness-diagnostic.html`) — Single-node: ART-27. 12-question diagnostic across policy, protocol, controls, and runtime pillars for agentic payment readiness. Graded with gap map. mandate_type: agent_guardrail_mandate.
- **MCP Server Deployability Diagnostic** (`chaingraph/art-28-mcp-server-deployability-diagnostic.html`) — Single-node: ART-28. Structured checklist for MCP server deployability covering transport, security, tool definitions, and client compatibility. mandate_type: compliance_control.

### Wave A OpenChainGraph Nodes (promoted from /tools/)
- `chaingraph/art-12-acp-checkout-conformance-validator.html` — ART-12 · OpenAI/Stripe ACP CheckoutRequest/Response field conformance, Shared Payment Token structure, ISO 4217 currency, TTL, signature prefix validation. mandate_type: payment_mandate.
- `chaingraph/art-15-agentic-mandate-sandbox.html` — ART-15 · Simulate and export agentic payment policies for tokenized A2A corridors (spend caps, MCC allowlists, velocity throttles, approval thresholds). mandate_type: agent_guardrail_mandate.
- `chaingraph/art-16-google-ap2-mandate-builder.html` — ART-16 · Constructs Google AP2 payment mandates (Intent/Cart/Payment trio). mandate_type: payment_mandate.
- `chaingraph/art-17-ap2-mcp-policy-validator.html` — ART-17 · Validates AP2 MCP policy definitions and generates MCP tool definitions. mandate_type: compliance_control.
- `chaingraph/art-18-mcp-developer-readiness-scorecard.html` — ART-18 · Scores MCP server/tool readiness for agent integration. mandate_type: compliance_control.
- `chaingraph/art-19-agentic-checkout-protocol-selector.html` — ART-19 · Protocol fit scoring for ACP, UCP, x402, TAP across 4 dimensions. mandate_type: routing_policy.
- `chaingraph/art-20-acp-ucp-product-feed-conformance-auditor.html` — ART-20 · Conformance scoring for ACP/UCP product and checkout feed schemas (5 field-schema arrays). mandate_type: scheme_rule.
- `chaingraph/art-21-agent-traffic-acceptance-policy-builder.html` — ART-21 · Builds agent traffic acceptance policies (verification level, velocity caps, rail allow/deny, refund posture, retry, block rules). mandate_type: agent_guardrail_mandate.
- `chaingraph/art-22-agentic-payments-protocol-comparator.html` — ART-22 · Compares AP2, ACP, x402, TAP, MC across 8 dimensions for 5 scenarios; §4 root of Agentic Rail chain. mandate_type: routing_policy.
- `chaingraph/art-23-visa-trusted-agent-protocol-inspector.html` — ART-23 · RFC 9421 Signature-Input parser + Visa TAP readiness scoring (5 READY_QS dimensions). mandate_type: compliance_control.
- `chaingraph/art-24-mastercard-agentic-token-builder.html` — ART-24 · Mastercard agentic token scope builder and linter (agent binding, merchant scope, limits, velocity, MCC). mandate_type: compliance_control.
- `chaingraph/art-25-a2a-agent-card-validator.html` — ART-25 · Google A2A Agent Card validator (required fields, auth scheme, capability flags). mandate_type: compliance_control.
- `chaingraph/art-26-x402-payload-decoder-flow-simulator.html` — ART-26 · x402 HTTP payment payload decoder and flow simulator. mandate_type: routing_policy.
- `chaingraph/art-27-agentic-readiness-diagnostic.html` — ART-27 · 12-question agentic payment readiness diagnostic (policy, protocol, controls, runtime). mandate_type: agent_guardrail_mandate.
- `chaingraph/art-28-mcp-server-deployability-diagnostic.html` — ART-28 · MCP server deployability checklist and gap analysis. mandate_type: compliance_control.

### Wave B Chains
- **DORA Readiness Chain** (`chaingraph/chains/dora-readiness.html`) — ART-29 (DORA readiness diagnostic, §4, root) → scenario routing by grade → ART-09 (DORA major-incident classifier, §4, terminal). DORA Art. 18/19 incident reporting. In force January 2025; ~22,000 in-scope entities.
- **Instant Payments / VoP Chain** (`chaingraph/chains/instant-payments-vop.html`) — Linear chain including ART-11 (VoP batch match-rate analyser, §4). EU Instant Payments Regulation; Verification of Payee mandatory October 2025.
- **AML Consolidation Chain** (`chaingraph/chains/aml-consolidation.html`) — Branching: ART-10 (AMLA transaction-typology risk scorer, §4, root) → Branch A: AMLR programme build-out → Branch B: AMLR network/cluster analysis. EU AMLR full application July 2027.
- **eInvoicing / VIDA Chain** (`chaingraph/chains/einvoicing-vida.html`) — Linear: T179 → T180 → ART-08 (EN 16931 e-invoice batch validator, §4) → T174 → T178. France large/medium mandate September 2026; EU ViDA.
- **Stablecoin Compliance Chain** (`chaingraph/chains/stablecoin-compliance.html`) — Linear: T53 → ART-06 (GENIUS Act reserve attestation, §4) → RCA-02 (MiCA reserve stress simulator, §4) → T386 → T390. GENIUS Act + MiCA dual-regime; two sequential §4 anchors.
- **EUDI Wallet Acceptance Chain** (`chaingraph/chains/eudi-wallet.html`) — Linear: T489 → T490 → T491 → ART-13 (EUDI wallet credential-acceptance readiness checker, §4) → T348. eIDAS 2.0 Art. 5a; member-state wallet rollout November 2026; FI acceptance December 2027.
- **Bank Capital & Liquidity Chain** (`chaingraph/chains/bank-capital-liquidity.html`) — Linear: SIM-03 (Basel RWA scenario modeler, §4, root) → SIM-01 (LCR/NSFR liquidity stress test, §4) → T471 → ART-07 (Basel 3.1 reporting delta calculator, §4) → T472 (Pillar 3 disclosure builder, terminal). Three sequential §4 anchors. Basel III/3.1 / CRR3; UK PRA PS1/26 January 2027.
- **Credit Decisioning & Loan Pricing Chain** (`chaingraph/chains/credit-decisioning.html`) — Linear: T198 → ML-02 (credit default risk scorer, §4) → T201 → T437 → T199 → T435. EU AI Act Art. 12/14 compliant logging for high-risk AI credit scoring systems.
- **Fraud Decisioning & ACH Fraud Chain** (`chaingraph/chains/fraud-decisioning.html`) — Branching: Branch A (Payment Fraud & APP Scam): ML-01 (isolation forest anomaly detector, §4, root) → T117 → MMS-03 (APP fraud graph simulator, §4) → T322 (terminal-A). Branch B (ACH Fraud / Nacha Phase 2): T492 → T493 → T494 (terminal-B). Nacha Phase 2 effective June 22 2026; PSR reimbursement liability.

### Wave B OpenChainGraph Nodes
- `chaingraph/art-29-dora-readiness-diagnostic.html` — ART-29 · 12-question scored DORA diagnostic across four pillars (ICT risk management, incident classification/reporting, resilience testing, third-party risk). Graded A–F with remediation map. Common entry point for the DORA Readiness Chain. mandate_type: infrastructure_mandate.
- `chaingraph/art-09-dora-incident-classifier.html` — ART-09 · DORA Art. 19/20 major-incident reporting threshold classifier and reporting-clock start. Inputs: clients affected, transaction value, downtime, geographic spread, cross-border component. Fast, deterministic. mandate_type: infrastructure_mandate.
- `chaingraph/art-10-amla-transaction-typology-risk-scorer.html` — ART-10 · Scores a synthetic transaction graph against AML typologies and FATF Travel Rule predicates; exports AML risk determination per account/cluster. Chains into CRY-01 for ZK proof of the same predicate. mandate_type: risk_control. Deadline: EU AMLR July 2027.
- `chaingraph/art-11-vop-batch-match-rate-analyser.html` — ART-11 · Batch IBAN-name matching: match/close-match/no-match classification, configurable strictness (exact/normalized/fuzzy), false-positive vs false-negative trade-off curves, per-corridor mismatch-rate distribution. mandate_type: compliance_mandate.
- `chaingraph/art-06-genius-act-reserve-attestation.html` — ART-06 · 1:1 reserve coverage check, reserve-composition eligibility against GENIUS Act permitted-asset classes, monthly reserve-report figures against AICPA 2025 Criteria for CEO/CFO certification. mandate_type: attestation_mandate. Deadline: GENIUS Act ≤ January 2027.
- `chaingraph/rca-02-mica-reserve-stress.html` — RCA-02 · Monte Carlo simulation of stablecoin reserve portfolios under MiCA Article 36 redemption stress and asset price shocks. 1,000 paths × 90-day horizon. Coverage ratio fan chart (P5–P95), breach probability, fire-sale contagion. Complements ART-06. mandate_type: liquidity_mandate.
- `chaingraph/art-08-en16931-einvoice-batch-validator.html` — ART-08 · Batch validation of e-invoices against EN 16931 mandatory fields, VAT logic, and country profiles (France, Germany, UK, Italy). France large/medium mandate September 2026; EU ViDA. mandate_type: compliance_mandate.
- `chaingraph/art-13-eudi-wallet-credential-readiness-checker.html` — ART-13 · eIDAS 2.0 verifiable-credential acceptance readiness against EUDI Wallet ARF v1.4 profiles. PID/QEAA/EAA attribute mapping, relying-party obligations, OpenID4VP/mdoc/SD-JWT-VC conformance gaps. mandate_type: compliance_mandate. Deadline: November 2026.
- `chaingraph/sim-03-basel-rwa-scenario-modeler.html` — SIM-03 · SA-CR / F-IRB / A-IRB RWA in parallel with output-floor comparison (72.5% §CAP30). BCBS d424 IRB capital formula with Φ⁻¹ rational approximation, LCG Monte Carlo. P5–P99 percentile table. mandate_type: capital_assessment. Deadline: UK PRA PS1/26 January 2027.
- `chaingraph/sim-01-lcr-nsfr-liquidity-stress-test.html` — SIM-01 · Monte Carlo simulation of LCR and NSFR under Basel III stress (CRR Art. 412/428, EBA GL/2017/01). 1,000 paths × 250 time steps. P5–P95 distribution, breach probability, time-to-breach, sensitivity tornado. mandate_type: liquidity_mandate.
- `chaingraph/art-07-basel31-reporting-delta-calculator.html` — ART-07 · Per-asset-class RWA delta (current vs Basel 3.1), output-floor binding analysis (72.5%), CET1 before/after, capital shortfall vs 12.5% total requirement. Six asset classes. Tornado chart. mandate_type: capital_assessment. Deadline: UK PRA PS1/26 January 2027.

- **Agent Identity & Trust-Chain** (`chaingraph/chains/agent-identity-trust.html`) — ART-32 → ART-04 → ART-02. A2A agent-card trust-chain → KYA identity attestation → spend-policy simulation.

- **Tempo Agentic Checkout** (`chaingraph/chains/tempo-agentic-checkout.html`) — ART-26 → ART-40 (W-D). x402/MPP decode → canonical pacs.008-subset settlement mapper: 32-byte Tempo memo → ISO 20022 remittance_information.

### Wave 10 — Circle Arc Network (shipped 2026-06-19)
Six nodes and eight chains covering Circle Arc L1 — EVM-compatible, USDC-as-native-gas, Malachite BFT (~350ms finality), public testnet Oct 2025, mainnet 2026. Guide hub: `chaingraph/guide-arc.html`.

#### Wave 10 Chains
- **Arc Fit Diagnostic** (`chaingraph/chains/arc-fit.html`) — ART-42 (D0). 12-question A–F fit diagnostic across CPN, StableFX, DvP, and agentic commerce dimensions. Arc fit score 0–120 gates entry to 7 downstream chains. CCTP v2 branch fires when ≥2 dims >0.
- **Arc CPN Payment** (`chaingraph/chains/arc-cpn-payment.html`) — ART-42 → ART-43 (W-A). CPN corridor economics vs SWIFT (WorldBank 5.5%), ACH (Nacha), SEPA, card. 3-year NPV, per-payment delta, migration verdict. ISO 20022 pacs.008.
- **Arc StableFX** (`chaingraph/chains/arc-stablefx.html`) — ART-42 → ART-44 (W-B). Herstatt risk quantification (BIS 1996) + annual FX spread savings for Arc 24/7 atomic PvP vs non-CLS bilateral. PFMI P12. BIS FX Global Code P35. ISO 20022 fxtr.008.
- **Arc xReserve Issuance** (`chaingraph/chains/arc-xreserve-issuance.html`) — ART-42 → ART-45 (W-C). xReserve compliance: GENIUS Act §4 eligible-asset 1:1 backing, §4(a)(11) yield prohibition, MiCA Art. 54, USYC limits (Hashnote/T-bill), attestation cadence, mint/burn segregation. ISO 20022 acmt.023.
- **Arc DvP Settlement** (`chaingraph/chains/arc-dvp-settlement.html`) — ART-42 → ART-44 → ART-46 (W-D). StableFX PvP risk model + ERC-4337 Paymaster economics for atomic DvP. PFMI P12. USDC-as-gas — no ETH bootstrap.
- **Arc Agentic Commerce** (`chaingraph/chains/arc-agentic-commerce.html`) — ART-42 → ART-46 → ART-43 (W-E). ERC-4337 Paymaster gas abstraction + CPN settlement for agent payment flows. Sponsorship break-even. 3-year NPV.
- **Arc Reserve Compliance** (`chaingraph/chains/arc-reserve-compliance.html`) — ART-45 → ART-44 (W-F). xReserve GENIUS/MiCA linter → StableFX Herstatt risk model. Full reserve compliance + risk picture for Arc stablecoin issuers.
- **Arc CCTP Transfer** (`chaingraph/chains/arc-cctp-transfer.html`) — ART-42 → ART-47 (W-G). CCTP v2 transfer: 6-check linter — domain eligibility (13 domains), Fast Transfer LP, Hook safety, v1 sunset migration (31 Jul 2026), notional >$10M flag. ISO 20022 pacs.009.

Deadline: 2026-07-31.

### §4 Artifact Schema (OpenChainGraph)
All OpenChainGraph nodes emit: `{ap2_version:"1.0.0", mandate_id, tool_id, execution_hash, chain:{parent_hashes, parent_tool_ids, chain_depth}, policy_parameters, output_payload, compliance_flags, audit_signature}`. execution_hash is WebCrypto SHA-256 over sorted-key JSON of policy_parameters + output_payload — verifiable client-side. Wave 9 artifacts additionally carry `dct:conformsTo` (W3C PROF profile URI) and `semantic_profile` token (iso20022:pacs.008-subset or iso20022:party-identification) per OpenChainGraph v0.3.1.
